about: SIFMA-US full closes projected forward from its recommendation rules, for payment schedules that need dates decades out (U.S. Government Securities Business Days, e.g. SOFR). Full closes only: early closes don't move payment dates. Fills only years no published SIFMA source covers; a year's projected rows are retired once SIFMA publishes it. Checked against SIFMA's own record for 1996-2026 (tests/test_rules.py lists every difference).

notes.Good Friday: Projected as a full close. In jobs-report years SIFMA usually recommends a noon early close instead (2010, 2012, 2015, 2021, 2023, 2026); those can't be known decades ahead, so a projected Good Friday is the most likely date to change when SIFMA publishes.
notes.Saturday holidays: SIFMA closes the Friday before, except for New Year's Day (no close in 2000, 2005, 2011, 2022) and Veterans Day (no close in 2000, 2006, 2017, 2023).
notes.Juneteenth: First a SIFMA holiday in 2022: in 2021 it fell on a Saturday with Fedwire open and SIFMA recommended no close. A Saturday Juneteenth since then (first: 2027) is projected like other Saturday holidays (the Friday before) until SIFMA's published year says otherwise.
